# PanePilot v0.14.0

PanePilot 0.14.0 adds deeper read-only Git exploration and makes project history,
previews, and launch flows easier to navigate.

## Highlights

- The new Aperture timeline explores local and remote branches from their exact tips
  in a searchable horizontal commit graph. Commit nodes show a compact authored age
  with the full local time on hover; history loading stays bounded, and copying a
  full SHA remains an explicit action. The timeline is read-only for local and SSH
  projects.
- LLM Chats now groups recorded sub-agent conversations beneath their parents,
  preserves searchable agent paths, shares transcript trimming across the current
  app session, and adds previous/next user-message navigation. A contextual
  **Sub-agents** action appears for the visible linked Codex thread when descendants
  exist.
- Files now opens bounded, sandboxed static HTML previews with project-relative
  assets. Launch dialogs focus their primary input and add numbered shortcuts, and
  stale Codex queued-input alerts clear when the live footer disappears. **Important:**
  new Codex, Claude Code, and LaTeX agent launchers now start with permission bypass
  selected; uncheck **YOLO mode** or **Disable permission checks** before starting if
  you want normal approval and sandbox prompts. Login shells are unaffected.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads. PanePilot has no
automatic update channel; install new versions from this repository.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First launch

This desktop build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm
the launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this
GitHub repository.
